cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline; do cp $D/$f.py $D/$f.py.bak_before_hand 2>/dev/null; done
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline classic_hand; do curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline classic_hand; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
ls -la $D/hand.json $D/trendline_learned.json 2>&1 | head -3
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
for tf in ("4h","1h","15m"):
    j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:18093/api/chart?sym=ZECUSDT&tf="+tf, timeout=60))
    t=j["tl"]; print(tf,"|",t["label"],"| линии:",{k:(round(v["s"],3),v["broken"]) for k,v in t["lines"].items()},"| сигналов",len(t["sigs"]),"| окно",len(j["t"]))
h=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:18093/api/hand?sym=ZECUSDT&tf=4h", timeout=60)); print("hand GET:",{k:(len(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v) for k,v in h.items() if k!="cfg"})
EOF
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18093/ | grep -c "Мои каналы"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c "hand_bounce"
